messages.text: What is signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

The supported relationship is that high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [4].
The supported oscilloscope link is that Interface Test maps to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices, while Power Distribution Network maps to scopes and network analyzers [4].
【推論】So “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” can only be treated as understanding where oscilloscope-based measurements fit inside SI/PI/SerDes validation, not as a formal product configuration [2][4].
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this understanding include whether an Interface Test setup should include scopes alongside BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1].
They include whether PDN validation should use scopes and network analyzers [1].
They include separating RefClk and PLL jitter performance measurements, which the source maps to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1].
They include separating ADC/DAC frontend performance measurements, which the source maps to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1].
They include PCB material measurement decisions using impedance TDR and DK/DF extraction [16].
They include material/stackup selection decisions using IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [16].
They include signal-integrity modeling/testing decisions using IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [16].
They include sampling testing decisions using IL, DK/DF, and impedance [16].
They include interconnect probing solution decisions such as ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool for PCB probing measurements of impedance, insertion loss, and return loss [45].
The passages do not provide an oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, test standard, or formal oscilloscope product configuration for this mapping [1][2].

High speed SerDes eco-chain
[[High speed SerDes eco-chain]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 9 對高速 SerDes 應用產業鏈的三層分類，分為上游基礎材料與核心元件、中游模組整合與生產製造、下游終端應用與市場部署。

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 9 題為 **High speed Serdes ecochain**，表格分成三段：

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 上游 — 基礎材料與核心元件
- 半導體晶片：控制器晶片、協定芯片、重驅動 / 重定時（Repeater / Re-timer）、介面協議轉換器等，用於 [[HDMI]]、[[USB]]、[[PCIe]]、[[DisplayPort]] 等高速數位介面。
- 光模組 / 光元件。
- [[PCB]] 印刷電路板材。
- 被動元件。
- 高頻高速連接線材與接頭：同軸 / 雙絞線（twinax）、飛線（Flyover®）、SFP / QSFP 倍率線纜，以及 [[Amphenol]]、[[Molex]]、[[Samtec]]、[[TE]] 提供的背板與板對板連結方案。

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 中游 — 模組整合與生產製造
- 晶片封測製造。

Time Domain Channel Properties › 來源中的定義
依 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]：

- TDCP 全名為 Time Domain Channel Properties。
- 它是 a new CSI quantity。
- 它 can provide additional information about time domain channel variability and User Equipment motion relative to the gNodeB。
- 來源說 TDCP measured via [[CSI-RS]] is being investigated to help the network track the channel's behavior over time。
- 來源在 development section 說 report quantity `tdcp` should be added，主要在 [[RRC]] 與 [[MAC]]。
- [[PHY]] can treat the new report type TDCP as a new [[CSI report]] type。

依 [[TDCP Reporting]]：

- TDCP is a new measurement introduced in Rel-18。
- TDCP provides CSI information on the relative mobility of the UE and the associated Doppler on the channel with the gNodeB。
- TDCP can be used to adjust configuration parameters such as codebook type or reference signal，以 adapt to channel conditions and ensure robust transmission in high-speed scenarios。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

The supported relationship is that high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [4].
The supported oscilloscope link is that Interface Test maps to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices, while Power Distribution Network maps to scopes and network analyzers [4].
【推論】So “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope” can only be treated as understanding where oscilloscope-based measurements fit inside SI/PI/SerDes validation, not as a formal product configuration [2][4].
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this understanding include whether an Interface Test setup should include scopes alongside BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1].
They include whether PDN validation should use scopes and network analyzers [1].
They include separating RefClk and PLL jitter performance measurements, which the source maps to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1].
They include separating ADC/DAC frontend performance measurements, which the source maps to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1].
They include PCB material measurement decisions using impedance TDR and DK/DF extraction [16].
They include material/stackup selection decisions using IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [16].
They include signal-integrity modeling/testing decisions using IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [16].
They include sampling testing decisions using IL, DK/DF, and impedance [16].
They include interconnect probing solution decisions such as ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool for PCB probing measurements of impedance, insertion loss, and return loss [45].
The passages do not provide an oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, test standard, or formal oscilloscope product configuration for this mapping [1][2].
